It is an established principle of law that the power to relax has to be strictly construed and is to be exercised judiciously and with caution. Further, the power to relax Order in Petition No. 58/TL/2024 Page 17 is to be exercised only when undue hardship is caused by the application of the rules or regulations. In the present case, the Petitioner is a transmission licensee who is already implementing the project defined under its scope through the TBCB mechanism. We, hereby, direct that a public notice under clause (a) of sub-section (5) of Section 15 of the Act be published to invite suggestions or objections to grant a transmission licence aforesaid.
